steps.message: The fix ensures that `LiveRender.position_cursor` and `LiveRender.restore_cursor` return an empty `Control` when the live renderable is empty (height 0), preventing unnecessary cursor movements and line erasures.

The issue was that `rich.live.Live` would perform cursor movements and line erasures even when the live renderable was empty, because `LiveRender.position_cursor` and `LiveRender.restore_cursor` only checked if `_shape` was not `None`, but not if the height was greater than zero. This caused unexpected behavior when `Live` was initialized with an empty string or `None`. The fix adds a check for `self._shape[1] > 0` in both methods to ensure they return an empty `Control` when no lines are rendered.
